image_description: A high-resolution, top-down studio shot of a single green fig cut in half horizontally. The image displays the exterior green skin and a small attached stem on the left, while the interior reveals a vibrant red-to-amber fleshy pulp densely packed with tiny seeds. The background is a clean, uniform white with soft shadowing indicating a light source from the upper left.
